Accessibility Notes: Clear line patterns for colorblind users. Add pattern overlays.

Color Guidance: Each bar: distinct color. Category: grouped same color. Sorted: descending order
Accessibility Notes: Easy to compare. Add value labels on bars for clarity.

Color Guidance: Limit to 5-7 slices. Use brand colors. Center value for donut.
Accessibility Notes: Always add data labels. Include legend with percentages.

Color Guidance: Use opacity 60-80%. Size encodes third variable in bubble charts. Color clusters.
Accessibility Notes: Add trend line annotation. Label axes clearly.

Color Guidance: Color by category. Size by value. High contrast borders.
Accessibility Notes: Use tooltips for all elements. Keyboard navigation for screen readers.

Color Guidance: Sequential color scale. Neutral for no-data regions.
Accessibility Notes: Include text alternative with data table. High contrast options.

Color Guidance: Single color fill. Border slightly darker. Bins clear.
Accessibility Notes: Label x-axis bins clearly. Add mean/median line.

Color Guidance: Primary metric: bars. Secondary: line. Dual y-axis if needed.
